gates.name: Data Leakage Audit
gates.description: Verify no cross-split leakage: machine ID isolation, SHA-256 duplicates, segment overlap.

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.description: Seeds controlled, dependencies frozen, provenance tracked.

gates.name: Shortcut Learning
gates.description: Model does not exploit metadata-only features or trivial artifacts.

gates.name: Baseline Comparisons
gates.description: Strong baselines reported: random, class-prior, single-score, fixed-fusion, classical ML.

gates.name: Ablation Studies
gates.description: Each component's contribution isolated: reliability gate, condition-awareness, score sources.
gates.recommendation: Run ablation studies and generate report.

gates.name: Statistical Validation
gates.description: Bootstrap CIs, significance tests (DeLong, McNemar, Wilcoxon), effect sizes.

gates.name: Subgroup Analysis
gates.description: Performance reported per machine type, machine ID, and noise condition.

gates.name: Robustness & Failure Analysis
gates.description: Failure modes characterized, confusion analysis, calibration errors, perturbations.

gates.name: Novelty Defined
gates.description: Clear research gap, mathematical formulation, novel contribution isolated from engineering.

gates.name: Manuscript Ready
gates.description: Complete manuscript with all figures, tables, references, and supplementary materials.

recommendation: Too many gates failing or not checked. Complete the pipeline before submission.
